notes.title: Halloween update
notes.notes:
Trick or treat! 
What could possibly be scary about a pumpkin? A worm. More so? Half a worm. Most? When the pumpkin eats its own worms. A terrifying Halloween update is coming! Soon you will be able to face scary, hungry pumpkins for which everyone is a worm.
Do you dare to enter the world of Pest Control? 

[previewyoutube=7G9dVpogkPs;full][/previewyoutube]

Survive or die - the event will only be available from 29.10.2021 to 31.10.2021!

NEW FEATURES

 Players can’t place the same trap multiple times.
 After completing a mission, pests were running like crazy.

notes.title: Pest Control Major Update! Full version now playable!
notes.notes:
Dear pest controllers,

Thank you all for the wait! Pest Control has now been updated to the full version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38169706/31b2e9bb3e06029164c1ef93da641108490a406d.png

We want to thanks to our players who have supported us along the way, who gave us a lot of valuable suggestions during the early access version of the game, so that we could improve our game

Here is a list on new features in full version:

 adventure mode,
 tower defence,
 dozens of missions in all modes,
 story mode,
 healing items,
 special weapons available during the missions,
 steam achievements,
 rewards room and bonuses from collectibles
 dozens of VFX effects,
 new music pieces,
 new type of pests – shapeshifters,
 possibility of expanding the base,
 lab and over a hundred studies,
 the main character's gym,
 modes of movement and behavior of the hero,
 types of pest behawior,
 the interface of the entire game,
 new tutorials,
 rebuilt workshop,
 item balance, price and statistics,
 balance of difficulty of task, earnings and experience gained,
 over half a thousand bugs have been corrected.

Thank you for staying with us! And enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38169706/10d6173f00320d21816dbb2a672885108aa73fe1.png
Update 0.5.1

GENERAL
• Lots of bug fixes, graphics and gameplay improvements.
• This version of the game requires you to start the game on a new save.

NEW FEATURES
• A new type of missions has been introduced - the adventure mode. The player places his units on the "battlefield", where battles are played automatically.
• The new office system - time system has been introduced. Time is needed to perform activities during free time - they increase the player's statistics.
• New stats have been added for the player - Strength, Energy, Stamina and Persistence.
• A training room has been added that allows you to increase the player's stats.
• A laboratory has been added to discover new technologies.
• Previous player skills were removed and new ones were added to the training room.
• New economy system. (5 main materials).
• New workshop (It works faster and has more features, plus it looks better!).
• New system of summaries and rewards for contracts.
• Added a new big machine. Scrapper.
• Added 7 new pests.
• Added the ability to buy pre-made traps in the shop.

notes.title: Update 0.4.2_H1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38169706/bb4099d4cc9cc1f49641114431ae86d41fdc52f9.png

Update 0.4.2_H1

GENERAL
• Pests now leave traces behind them to help in locating them. Traces have their own strength and can be strengthened with a scanner or a new inspect action. They decay every turn cycle.
• Pests (and other objects) may now differ in appearance (randomly) - this is currently only implemented in the rat.
• All characters in the game now rotate smoothly, not instantaneously.
• New pest icons have been added - now each pest has its own unique icon on the timeline.
• New loading screens have been added depending on the contract being loaded.
• The function of appearing and disappearing of objects when they are not in the player's field of view has been improved.
• Aligned the position of the in-game scanner buton.
• In-game objectives window has been reduced in size.
• Refreshing the spider model and its animations.
• Added new idle animations for player.
• Added a book in the workshop that will teach or remind you of what works.
• Added the cart in the workshop that allows you to buy items.
• Improved the level objectives.
• Added no-items warning to complete the job.
• Adds extra damage if it is dealt from the back or the side.
• Added even more in-game hints (tooltips).
• Adding a storyline at the beginning of the game.
• Added buttons to skip stories. (Ironically).
• Hovering over tiles no longer works if the cursor is over any interface element.
• Missing translations added.
• Light reflection on pest traces has been reduced.

FIXES
• Bug fixes and visual improvements.
• Fixed an issue where characters would stop on tiles without any interactive objects on them.
• Fixed bugs on scenes.
• Fixed a bug with the gameplay getting stuck when pest traces were disappearing.
• Fixed a bug with traces of pests that have already disappeared showing up in the tooltip.
• Fixed a bug with pest traces tooltip not disappearing if the tile with traces was on the edge of a level.
• Fixed a bug with tooltips not disappearing after loading a new scene.

notes.title: Winter Update 0.4.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38169706/764a6ce6014a3ed08b8d08bee832647ab02a75f3.png

GENERAL

 Added an information about the currently played contract.
 Added new skills.
 Added new weapon: Slingshot.
 Added the possibility of upgrading weapons.
 Added new clients (11) including the new 13 missions.
 Improved tutorial.
 Changed skills cost.
 A completely new artificial intelligence system has been created.
 The ability to dodge the approaching attack has been added (it is performed automatically with a percentage chance) - it costs 5 action points; if a player does not have that many points, the chance to dodge is halved.
 Enemy markers now move with them, instead of jumping between tiles.
 Added a system of selecting the movement mode (stealth increases the amount of movement points used, but reduces the chance of being detected, and running reduces the amount of movement points used and increases the chance of being detected).
 A behavior selection system has been added:
- In the first mode, the player's character is passive and has a 10% chance to dodge.
- In the second mode, the player's character is defensive and has a 50% chance to dodge and a 25% chance for each opponent's move nearby that he will approach him and block his path during not his turn, provided that he has enough action points left from previous turn.
- In the third mode, the player's character is aggressive, has a 25% chance to dodge, a 25% chance to block a route and a 25% chance to attack a nearby moving enemy, if he has enough remaining action points.
 The ability to delete save files has been added.
 Added additional information identifying the build to the main game menu.
 Added new slot for secondary weapon.
 Added new player statistic: Critical hit.
 Adding a new animation for a sling with a bullet. 
 Added trap animations in workshop.
 Added new animations and particles for traps.
 Added new icons for skills, traps, items and more.
 Added new notifications for items and battle log.
 Added health bar for smudges.
 Refreshed inventory.
 Refreshed scanner.
 Refreshed and moderned Tooltips.
 Refreshed and moderned portraits on the turn list.

FIXES

 Fixed bugs related to in-game audio (e.g. overlapping tracks).
 Fixed translation.
 Fixed player skills.
 Fixed bug with jumping tile movement markers.
 Fixed a bug updating the audio volume only after entering settings.
 Minor bug fixes and visual fixes.
